ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a relationship schematic diagram of the impacts of "building a reservoir" on the natural geographical environment. At the top, "building a reservoir" branches downward into impacts such as "forming an artificial lake" and "changing downstream river flow velocity and discharge"; in the middle-lower part of the figure, the branch "local climate" can be seen, and below it corresponds to a blank box labeled "Yi." Then reason: after a reservoir is built, a relatively large water surface is formed, the water area expands, evaporation strengthens, and air humidity increases; at the same time, the heat capacity of the water body is large, and it can regulate the daily range and annual range of air temperature, making nearby climate conditions improve somewhat. Therefore, at place Yi, "improve the local climate" should be added.
